Container.Name: prusa-connect
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: prusa connect prusalink 3d printer fleet print farm mk4 core one xl
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted Prusa Connect server for your Prusa printers: web UI, REST API, print file storage and printer management on your own network.
BEFORE FIRST START: the config file is mounted read-only and Docker will create a folder in its place if the file is missing. From the Unraid terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/prusa-connect/{config.d,storage,data,tmp} curl -fL -o /mnt/user/appdata/prusa-connect/config.yaml https://github.com/prusa3d/prusa-connect/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.1/config.yaml chown -R 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/prusa-connect
Config file template (every key is documented in comments): https://github.com/prusa3d/prusa-connect/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.1/config.yaml
The container runs as uid 10001 with a read-only root filesystem and no Linux capabilities, so the appdata folders must be owned by 10001:10001. The server reads config.yaml only at start; restart the container after editing it.
Open the web UI and answer the first-run questions (how people sign in, how printers join).
Optional UDP ports are not published by default; add them with Add another Port: 123 (time server, only if the host is not already using it; Unraid's own NTP usually is), 13514 and 8514 (printer logs extension). Finding nearby printers by mDNS only works with Network Type set to Host.
Web interface: http://UNRAID_IP:8080

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: config.yaml from the release, downloaded before first start (see Overview). Read-only, read at container start

Config.Name: Database and Settings
Config.Description: Database and settings the server writes. Must be owned by 10001:10001

Config.Name: Print Files
Config.Description: Uploaded print files. Must be owned by 10001:10001

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Extensions and their data. Must be owned by 10001:10001

Config.Name: Temp
Config.Description: Scratch space, the root filesystem is read-only. Large uploads pass through here. Must be owned by 10001:10001
